name: What considerations are important when choosing a contractor for an ADU conversion?

mainEntity.name: What considerations are important when choosing a contractor for an ADU conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your ADU conversion, prioritize experience specifically with ADU projects and local regulations in areas like Irvine or Yorba Linda. Look for contractors with proper licensing, insurance, and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Good communication, transparent pricing, and positive client testimonials are also crucial. Ensure they handle the entire process, from design and permitting to construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with ADU-specific experience, proper licensing, insurance, strong communication, transparent pricing, and positive references, especially in your local area.
